title: Normalized solutions to a class of Kirchhoff type equations with a logarithmic perturbation
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of normalized solutions to the Kirchhoff type equation with a logarithmic perturbation\[-\left(a+b\int_{\mathbb{R}^3}|\nabla u|^2 \,\mathrm{d}x \right) Δu=λu+|u|^{p-2}u+u\log u^2,\quad x \in\mathbb{R}^3, \]under the normalized constraint $\int_{\mathbb{R}^3} u^2 \,\mathrm{d}x = c^2$, where $a,b>0$, $2 0$ is a constant, and $λ\in\mathbb{R}$ emerges as a Lagrange multiplier which is not a priori known. A unified variational framework is developed based on Orlicz spaces together with the Pohozaev constraint method and refined fiber map analysis. For…
